description: Source code for the DataFrameWriter class in Apache Spark, defining methods for writing DataFrames to external storage with various formats and options.

classes.name: DataFrameWriter
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods to write a Dataset to external storage with various formats and options.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Sets the save mode (Overwrite, Append, Ignore, ErrorIfExists) for writing data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Specifies the output data source format (e.g., parquet, json).

methods.name: option
methods.description: Adds an output option for the data source, with overloads for String, Boolean, Long, Double values.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Adds multiple output options from Scala Map or Java Map.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Partitions output data by specified columns.

methods.name: bucketBy
methods.description: Buckets output data by specified columns.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Sorts output data by specified columns.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Clusters output data by specified columns.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves DataFrame content to a specified path.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves DataFrame content as a table.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves DataFrame content to a specified path.

methods.name: saveAsTable
methods.description: Saves DataFrame content as a named table.

methods.name: insertInto
methods.description: Inserts DataFrame content into an existing table.

methods.name: jdbc
methods.description: Saves DataFrame to an external database table via JDBC with connection properties.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Saves DataFrame in JSON format at specified path.

methods.name: parquet
methods.description: Saves DataFrame in Parquet format at specified path.

methods.name: orc
methods.description: Saves DataFrame in ORC format at specified path.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Saves DataFrame as text files at specified path.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Saves DataFrame in CSV format at specified path.

methods.name: xml
methods.description: Saves DataFrame in XML format at specified path.

methods.name: isBucketed
methods.description: Checks if data is bucketed based on current configuration.

methods.name: assertNotBucketed
methods.description: Ensures data is not bucketed before performing certain operations.

methods.name: assertNotPartitioned
methods.description: Ensures data is not partitioned before performing certain operations.

methods.name: assertNotClustered
methods.description: Ensures data is not clustered before performing certain operations.

methods.name: validatePartitioning
methods.description: Validates that clusterBy is not used with partitionBy or bucketBy.
